fullText.simplified:
黑衣人

    荆州的军队一支箭都没有，很快就败了。
    刘表很害怕，带着一些助手和军队从河边跑到了一个城里。他们进了城，马上把城门关上，不敢再出来了。
    城门又高又大，江东的军队打不进去，就住在城外，慢慢打。刘表在城里住了十多天，孙坚的军队就在外面打了十多天，虽然没有打进去，但刘表每天都害怕极了。
    刘表问助手们：“怎么办？我们不能一直在城里不出去啊？吃的东西快没有了。”
    有个助手想了想，说：“我有个办法，可以杀了孙坚。”
    刘表不敢相信：“我们人少，孙坚人多，怎么杀他？”
    助手说：“只用三十人，就可以杀孙坚。”
    刘表眼睛变大了，助手说出了自己的想法。刘表想了想，说：“你的想法不错，但孙坚会相信吗？”
    助手说：“孙坚太想杀您了，他会相信的。”
    晚上，天很黑。
    城门开了，十多个穿着黑衣的人骑着马出来了。他们往城外的大路跑去，跑得又快又急，像是有什么重要的事情。跑在最前面的那个人拿着大刀，和刘表很像。
    江东军队这边，孙坚和几个助手站在城外的小山上，把黑衣人看得很清楚。
    孙坚笑着说：“想跑？能跑到哪儿去？”说完就要跟上去，他的助手说：“请等一下。现在我们人太少，我去找一些人来帮忙。”
    孙坚大笑着说：“等你找到人，他们就跑远了。他们只有十几个人，我们不用害怕。”
    孙坚骑着马跟过去了，助手们没有办法，只能跟着他一起跑。他们很快跑到了那十几个黑衣人的后面，黑衣人们害怕极了，跑得更快了。孙坚跟在拿大刀的那个黑衣人后面，孙坚的助手们没有孙坚快，很快就看不到孙坚了。
    拿大刀的黑衣人往山里跑，孙坚跟着他往山里跑。
    天很黑，山里的树很多，孙坚看不清楚，只能跟着黑衣人骑马的声音往前跑。
    突然，那个骑马的声音没有了。
fullText.traditional:
黑衣人

    荊州的軍隊一支箭都沒有，很快就敗了。
    劉表很害怕，帶著一些助手和軍隊從河邊跑到了一個城裡。他們進了城，馬上把城門關上，不敢再出來了。
    城門又高又大，江東的軍隊打不進去，就住在城外，慢慢打。劉表在城裡住了十多天，孫堅的軍隊就在外面打了十多天，雖然沒有打進去，但劉表每天都害怕極了。
    劉表問助手們：“怎麼辦？我們不能一直在城裡不出去啊？吃的東西快沒有了。”
    有個助手想了想，說：“我有個辦法，可以殺了孫堅。”
    劉表不敢相信：“我們人少，孫堅人多，怎麼殺他？”
    助手說：“只用三十人，就可以殺孫堅。”
    劉表眼睛變大了，助手說出了自己的想法。劉表想了想，說：“你的想法不錯，但孫堅會相信嗎？”
    助手說：“孫堅太想殺您了，他會相信的。”
    晚上，天很黑。
    城門開了，十多個穿著黑衣的人騎著馬出來了。他們往城外的大路跑去，跑得又快又急，像是有什麼重要的事情。跑在最前面的那個人拿著大刀，和劉表很像。
    江東軍隊這邊，孫堅和幾個助手站在城外的小山上，把黑衣人看得很清楚。
    孫堅笑著說：“想跑？能跑到哪兒去？”說完就要跟上去，他的助手說：“請等一下。現在我們人太少，我去找一些人來幫忙。”
    孫堅大笑著說：“等你找到人，他們就跑遠了。他們只有十幾個人，我們不用害怕。”
    孫堅騎著馬跟過去了，助手們沒有辦法，只能跟著他一起跑。他們很快跑到了那十幾個黑衣人的後面，黑衣人們害怕極了，跑得更快了。孫堅跟在拿大刀的那個黑衣人後面，孫堅的助手們沒有孫堅快，很快就看不到孫堅了。
    拿大刀的黑衣人往山裡跑，孫堅跟著他往山裡跑。
    天很黑，山裡的樹很多，孫堅看不清楚，只能跟著黑衣人騎馬的聲音往前跑。
    突然，那個騎馬的聲音沒有了。

sentences.simplified: 荆州的军队一支箭都没有，很快就败了。
sentences.traditional: 荊州的軍隊一支箭都沒有，很快就敗了。
sentences.pinyin: jīng zhōu de jūn duì yì zhī jiàn dōu méi yǒu hěn kuài jiù bài le
sentences.english: Jingzhou’s troops did not have a single arrow left and were defeated quickly.

sentences.simplified: 刘表很害怕，带着一些助手和军队从河边跑到了一个城里。
sentences.traditional: 劉表很害怕，帶著一些助手和軍隊從河邊跑到了一個城裡。
sentences.pinyin: liú biǎo hěn hài pà dài zhe yì xiē zhù shǒu hé jūn duì cóng hé biān pǎo dào le yí ge chéng lǐ
sentences.english: Liu Biao was very scared and fled from the river to a city with some assistants and troops.

sentences.simplified: 他们进了城，马上把城门关上，不敢再出来了。
sentences.traditional: 他們進了城，馬上把城門關上，不敢再出來了。
sentences.pinyin: tā men jìn le chéng mǎ shàng bǎ chéng mén guān shàng bù gǎn zài chū lái le
sentences.english: They entered the city and immediately closed the city gates, not daring to come out again.

sentences.simplified: 城门又高又大，江东的军队打不进去，
sentences.traditional: 城門又高又大，江東的軍隊打不進去，
sentences.pinyin: chéng mén yòu gāo yòu dà jiāng dōng de jūn duì dǎ bú jìn qù
sentences.english: The city gates were both tall and large, and the troops from Jiangdong could not fight their way in.

sentences.simplified: 就住在城外，慢慢打。
sentences.traditional: 就住在城外，慢慢打。
sentences.pinyin: jiù zhù zài chéng wài màn man dǎ
sentences.english: So, they stayed outside the city and fought slowly.

sentences.simplified: 刘表在城里住了十多天，孙坚的军队就在外面打了十多天，
sentences.traditional: 劉表在城裡住了十多天，孫堅的軍隊就在外面打了十多天，
sentences.pinyin: liú biǎo zài chéng lǐ zhù le shí duō tiān sūn jiān de jūn duì jiù zài wài miàn dǎ le shí duō tiān
sentences.english: Liu Biao stayed in the city for more than 10 days, so Sun Jian’s troops fought outside for more than 10 days.

sentences.simplified: 虽然没有打进去，但刘表每天都害怕极了。
sentences.traditional: 雖然沒有打進去，但劉表每天都害怕極了。
sentences.pinyin: suī rán méi yǒu dǎ jìn qù dàn liú biǎo měi tiān dōu hài pà jí le
sentences.english: Even though they could not fight their way inside, Liu Biao was extremely afraid every day.

sentences.simplified: 刘表问助手们：“怎么办？我们不能一直在城里不出去啊？吃的东西快没有了。”
sentences.traditional: 劉表問助手們：“怎麼辦？我們不能一直在城裡不出去啊？吃的東西快沒有了。”
sentences.pinyin: liú biǎo wèn zhù shǒu men zěn me bàn wǒ men bù néng yì zhí zài chéng lǐ bù chū qù a chī de dōng xi kuài méi yǒu le
sentences.english: Liu Biao asked his assistants, “What should we do? We can’t stay in the city and not go outside forever. We’re almost out of food.”

sentences.simplified: 有个助手想了想，说：“我有个办法，可以杀了孙坚。”
sentences.traditional: 有個助手想了想，說：“我有個辦法，可以殺了孫堅。”
sentences.pinyin: yǒu ge zhù shǒu xiǎng le xiǎng shuō wǒ yǒu ge bàn fǎ kě yǐ shā le sūn jiān
sentences.english: One of the assistants thought about it and said, “I have an idea to kill Sun Jian.”

sentences.simplified: 刘表不敢相信：“我们人少，孙坚人多，怎么杀他？”
sentences.traditional: 劉表不敢相信：“我們人少，孫堅人多，怎麼殺他？”
sentences.pinyin: liú biǎo bù gǎn xiāng xìn wǒ men rén shǎo sūn jiān rén duō zěn me shā tā
sentences.english: Liu Biao couldn’t believe it: “Our people are few, and Sun Jian’s people are many. How can we kill him?”

sentences.simplified: 助手说：“只用三十人，就可以杀孙坚。”
sentences.traditional: 助手說：“只用三十人，就可以殺孫堅。”
sentences.pinyin: zhù shǒu shuō zhǐ yòng sān shí rén jiù kě yǐ shā sūn jiān
sentences.english: His assistant said, “We can kill Sun Jian with only 30 men.”

sentences.simplified: 刘表眼睛变大了，助手说出了自己的想法。
sentences.traditional: 劉表眼睛變大了，助手說出了自己的想法。
sentences.pinyin: liú biǎo yǎn jing biàn dà le zhù shǒu shuō chū le zì jǐ de xiǎng fǎ
sentences.english: Liu Biao’s eyes widened, and his assistant explained his idea.

sentences.simplified: 刘表想了想，说：“你的想法不错，但孙坚会相信吗？”
sentences.traditional: 劉表想了想，說：“你的想法不錯，但孫堅會相信嗎？”
sentences.pinyin: liú biǎo xiǎng le xiǎng shuō nǐ de xiǎng fǎ bú cuò dàn sūn jiān huì xiāng xìn ma
sentences.english: Liu Biao thought about it and said, “Your idea is good, but will Sun Jian believe it?”

sentences.simplified: 助手说：“孙坚太想杀您了，他会相信的。”
sentences.traditional: 助手說：“孫堅太想殺您了，他會相信的。”
sentences.pinyin: zhù shǒu shuō sūn jiān tài xiǎng shā nín le tā huì xiāng xìn de
sentences.english: His assistant said, “Sun Jian really wants to kill you. He will believe it.”

sentences.simplified: 晚上，天很黑。
sentences.traditional: 晚上，天很黑。
sentences.pinyin: wǎn shang tiān hěn hēi
sentences.english: At night, it was very dark.

sentences.simplified: 城门开了，十多个穿着黑衣的人骑着马出来了。
sentences.traditional: 城門開了，十多個穿著黑衣的人騎著馬出來了。
sentences.pinyin: chéng mén kāi le shí duō ge chuān zhe hēi yī de rén qí zhe mǎ chū lái le
sentences.english: The city gates opened, and 10 or so men in black rode out on horseback.

sentences.simplified: 他们往城外的大路跑去，跑得又快又急，像是有什么重要的事情。
sentences.traditional: 他們往城外的大路跑去，跑得又快又急，像是有什麼重要的事情。
sentences.pinyin: tā men wǎng chéng wài de dà lù pǎo qù pǎo de yòu kuài yòu jí xiàng shì yǒu shén me zhòng yào de shì qing
sentences.english: They ran towards the main road outside the city, running fast and furiously as if something important was going on.

sentences.simplified: 跑在最前面的那个人拿着大刀，和刘表很像。
sentences.traditional: 跑在最前面的那個人拿著大刀，和劉表很像。
sentences.pinyin: pǎo zài zuì qián miàn de nà ge rén ná zhe dà dāo hé liú biǎo hěn xiàng
sentences.english: The man running in the very front held a large sword, and he looked a lot like Liu Biao.

sentences.simplified: 江东军队这边，孙坚和几个助手站在城外的小山上，把黑衣人看得很清楚。
sentences.traditional: 江東軍隊這邊，孫堅和幾個助手站在城外的小山上，把黑衣人看得很清楚。
sentences.pinyin: jiāng dōng jūn duì zhè biān sūn jiān hé jǐ ge zhù shǒu zhàn zài chéng wài de xiǎo shān shang bǎ hēi yī rén kàn de hěn qīng chu
sentences.english: On the Jiangdong army side, Sun Jian and several assistants stood on a hill outside the city and could see the men in black very clearly.

sentences.simplified: 孙坚笑着说：“想跑？能跑到哪儿去？”
sentences.traditional: 孫堅笑著說：“想跑？能跑到哪兒去？”
sentences.pinyin: sūn jiān xiào zhe shuō xiǎng pǎo néng pǎo dào nǎ'r qù
sentences.english: Sun Jian laughed and said, “You want to escape? Where can you escape to?”

sentences.simplified: 说完就要跟上去，他的助手说：
sentences.traditional: 說完就要跟上去，他的助手說：
sentences.pinyin: shuō wán jiù yào gēn shàng qù tā de zhù shǒu shuō
sentences.english: After saying this, he was about to go up to them when his assistant said, ..

sentences.simplified: “请等一下。现在我们人太少，我去找一些人来帮忙。”
sentences.traditional: “請等一下。現在我們人太少，我去找一些人來幫忙。”
sentences.pinyin: qǐng děng yí xià xiàn zài wǒ men rén tài shǎo wǒ qù zhǎo yì xiē rén lái bāng máng
sentences.english: .. “Please wait a minute. Right now our men are too few; I’m going to find some men to help us out.”

sentences.simplified: 孙坚大笑着说：“等你找到人，他们就跑远了。他们只有十几个人，我们不用害怕。”
sentences.traditional: 孫堅大笑著說：“等你找到人，他們就跑遠了。他們只有十幾個人，我們不用害怕。”
sentences.pinyin: sūn jiān dà xiào zhe shuō děng nǐ zhǎo dào rén tā men jiù pǎo yuǎn le tā men zhǐ yǒu shí jǐ ge rén wǒ men bú yòng hài pà
sentences.english: Sun Jian laughed and said, “By the time you find men, they will be long gone. They only have 10 or so men, so we have nothing to fear.”

sentences.simplified: 孙坚骑着马跟过去了，助手们没有办法，只能跟着他一起跑。
sentences.traditional: 孫堅騎著馬跟過去了，助手們沒有辦法，只能跟著他一起跑。
sentences.pinyin: sūn jiān qí zhe mǎ gēn guò qu le zhù shǒu men méi yǒu bàn fǎ zhǐ néng gēn zhe tā yì qǐ pǎo
sentences.english: Sun Jian rode over on horseback, and his assistants had no choice but to follow him.

sentences.simplified: 他们很快跑到了那十几个黑衣人的后面，黑衣人们害怕极了，跑得更快了。
sentences.traditional: 他們很快跑到了那十幾個黑衣人的後面，黑衣人們害怕極了，跑得更快了。
sentences.pinyin: tā men hěn kuài pǎo dào le nà shí jǐ ge hēi yī rén de hòu miàn hēi yī rén men hài pà jí le pǎo de gèng kuài le
sentences.english: They quickly came up behind the 10 or so men in black. The men in black were very scared and ran even faster.

sentences.simplified: 孙坚跟在拿大刀的那个黑衣人后面，
sentences.traditional: 孫堅跟在拿大刀的那個黑衣人後面，
sentences.pinyin: sūn jiān gēn zài ná dà dāo de nà ge hēi yī rén hòu miàn
sentences.english: Sun Jian followed right behind the man in black holding the large sword.

sentences.simplified: 孙坚的助手们没有孙坚快，很快就看不到孙坚了。
sentences.traditional: 孫堅的助手們沒有孫堅快，很快就看不到孫堅了。
sentences.pinyin: sūn jiān de zhù shǒu men méi yǒu sūn jiān kuài hěn kuài jiù kàn bú dào sūn jiān le
sentences.english: Sun Jian’s assistants were not as fast as Sun Jian, and soon, Sun Jian was out of sight.

sentences.simplified: 拿大刀的黑衣人往山里跑，孙坚跟着他往山里跑。
sentences.traditional: 拿大刀的黑衣人往山裡跑，孫堅跟著他往山裡跑。
sentences.pinyin: ná dà dāo de hēi yī rén wǎng shān lǐ pǎo sūn jiān gēn zhe tā wǎng shān lǐ pǎo
sentences.english: The man in black holding the large sword ran towards the mountain, and Sun Jian followed him into the mountain.

sentences.simplified: 天很黑，山里的树很多，
sentences.traditional: 天很黑，山裡的樹很多，
sentences.pinyin: tiān hěn hēi shān lǐ de shù hěn duō
sentences.english: It was very dark, and there were many trees on the mountain.

sentences.simplified: 孙坚看不清楚，只能跟着黑衣人骑马的声音往前跑。
sentences.traditional: 孫堅看不清楚，只能跟著黑衣人騎馬的聲音往前跑。
sentences.pinyin: sūn jiān kàn bù qīng chu zhǐ néng gēn zhe hēi yī rén qí mǎ de shēng yīn wǎng qián pǎo
sentences.english: Sun Jian could not see very clearly, and could only continue forward by following the sound of the man in black riding his horse.

sentences.simplified: 突然，那个骑马的声音没有了。
sentences.traditional: 突然，那個騎馬的聲音沒有了。
sentences.pinyin: tū rán nà ge qí mǎ de shēng yīn méi yǒu le
sentences.english: Suddenly, the sound of riding on horseback disappeared.

sentence_translations: Men in Black
Jingzhou’s troops did not have a single arrow left and were defeated quickly.
Liu Biao was very scared and fled from the river to a city with some assistants and troops.
They entered the city and immediately closed the city gates, not daring to come out again.
The city gates were both tall and large, and the troops from Jiangdong could not fight their way in.
So, they stayed outside the city and fought slowly.
Liu Biao stayed in the city for more than 10 days, so Sun Jian’s troops fought outside for more than 10 days.
Even though they could not fight their way inside, Liu Biao was extremely afraid every day.
Liu Biao asked his assistants, “What should we do? We can’t stay in the city and not go outside forever. We’re almost out of food.”
One of the assistants thought about it and said, “I have an idea to kill Sun Jian.”
Liu Biao couldn’t believe it: “Our people are few, and Sun Jian’s people are many. How can we kill him?”
His assistant said, “We can kill Sun Jian with only 30 men.”
Liu Biao’s eyes widened, and his assistant explained his idea.
Liu Biao thought about it and said, “Your idea is good, but will Sun Jian believe it?”
His assistant said, “Sun Jian really wants to kill you. He will believe it.”
At night, it was very dark.
The city gates opened, and 10 or so men in black rode out on horseback.
They ran towards the main road outside the city, running fast and furiously as if something important was going on.
The man running in the very front held a large sword, and he looked a lot like Liu Biao.
On the Jiangdong army side, Sun Jian and several assistants stood on a hill outside the city and could see the men in black very clearly.
Sun Jian laughed and said, “You want to escape? Where can you escape to?”
After saying this, he was about to go up to them when his assistant said, ..
.. “Please wait a minute. Right now our men are too few; I’m going to find some men to help us out.”
Sun Jian laughed and said, “By the time you find men, they will be long gone. They only have 10 or so men, so we have nothing to fear.”
Sun Jian rode over on horseback, and his assistants had no choice but to follow him.
They quickly came up behind the 10 or so men in black. The men in black were very scared and ran even faster.
Sun Jian followed right behind the man in black holding the large sword.
Sun Jian’s assistants were not as fast as Sun Jian, and soon, Sun Jian was out of sight.
The man in black holding the large sword ran towards the mountain, and Sun Jian followed him into the mountain.
It was very dark, and there were many trees on the mountain.
Sun Jian could not see very clearly, and could only continue forward by following the sound of the man in black riding his horse.
Suddenly, the sound of riding on horseback disappeared.
